name: Selenium
effects: Essential trace element — selenoprotein cofactor (glutathione peroxidase, thioredoxin reductase)
Thyroid hormone metabolism (T4 to T3 conversion) requires selenoproteins
Selenomethionine form has superior bioavailability and retention vs inorganic forms
Narrow therapeutic window — UL 400 mcg/day; chronic excess causes selenosis
Selenosis: garlic breath, hair loss, nail brittleness, neurological symptoms
